cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you leave tonight's book club, we close the discussion together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we can leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come to your window. Give me ten seconds of your taxi time; I only need you through 'until next time.'
